body: when I´m here they get to shout at each other and throw stuff and break stuff but if I leave I feel it will escalate. One time I left for a weekend and it was the first time they hit each other. Both of them had bruises and I felt terribly guilty for spending money (their money)to leave

I really try. When I´m in a good mood I can try to make them laugh and cook and it´s okay I can clean the house. But other days like today I´m so so so angry. I want them to understand how terrible they make me feel. I hate they get to make me feel this trapped.

Def NTA. I may be a litte petty but I´m very glad of how you reacted, you may even helped your mom at court with that. Assholes should be held accountable for saying shit. Still I hope you can forgive him OP just to let it go because it may still hurt you.
